app.name: Roots
app.tagline: Build your family tree together and keep your family's memories in one private place.

tree.placeholderBody: This is where your family will grow, one person at a time.

feed.placeholderBody: Memories your relatives add will appear here.

map.placeholderBody: See where your family has lived, from birthplaces to hometowns.

profile.placeholderBody: Your account and settings will live here.

welcome.ageRequired: Please confirm you're 18 or older to continue.
welcome.privacyNote: Private by default. Only relatives you invite can see your family's tree.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
email.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open the email on this phone and tap the link.
checkEmail.codeIntro: Link not working? Type the code from the same email instead.
checkEmail.invalidCode: Enter the number from the email. It's usually 6 digits.
checkEmail.resent: We sent a new email. It can take a minute to arrive.

authErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute, then try again.
authErrors.expiredOrInvalid: That link or code has expired or isn't right. Ask for a new email and use the newest one.
authErrors.wrongDevice: That link was opened outside this app, so it couldn't sign you in here. Open the email on this phone, or type the code from the email instead.
authErrors.serverError: We couldn't send your sign-in email just now. This is a problem on our side, not your connection. Please try again in a few minutes.
authErrors.network: We couldn't reach the internet. Check your connection and try again.
authErrors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen ran into a problem. We've been notified. Your family's data is safe.

dev.title: Developer tools
dev.intro: Only visible while developing. Use these to check that monitoring and flags are working.
dev.sentryOff: Off: add EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN to .env and restart.
dev.redScreenNote: In development, a red error screen appears after each test. That's expected; dismiss it.
dev.posthogOn: On: screen views are being sent.
dev.posthogOff: Off: add EXPO_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY to .env and restart.
dev.flagsLoaded: Loaded from Supabase at app start.
